### Extreme Networks Schedules Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results Conference Call


July 9, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s205.q4cdn.com/756692490/files/doc_news/Extreme-Networks-Schedules-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-Year-2026-Financial-Results-Conference-Call-2026.pdf)


MORRISVILLE, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Extreme Networks, Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.extremenetworks.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3D24_PR_Q1ResultsCall_0000_CORP_AAD_REF_LPG_WW_EN_PRE_home%26utm_medium%3DReferral%26utm_source%3DQ1ResultsCall%26utm_content%3Dhome&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=Extreme+Networks%2C+Inc&index=1&md5=bbe83c9e63e9470fbd8aa346c2b73fb5) . (Nasdaq: EXTR), a leader in AI-powered automation for networking, today announced plans to release financial results for its fourth fiscal quarter and fiscal year 2026, ended June 30, 2026. The company will announce before market open on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, followed by an earnings conference call and webcast at 8:00 a.m. ET.


The details for the webcast are:


When:


Wednesday, August 5, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. ET (5:00 a.m. PT)


Where:


[https://investor.extremenetworks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.extremenetworks.com&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.extremenetworks.com&index=2&md5=53fb30077647e44e994c2d863e642bd6)


Dial in/
webcast:


To access the call by phone or webcast, please go to this link ([Registration Link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F101773086&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=Registration+Link&index=3&md5=d1114e0126c2864de1a1364f93dfdd4a) ) **** and you will be provided with dial-in details. To avoid delays, we encourage participants to dial into the conference call fifteen minutes ahead of the scheduled start time.


Q&A Participation:


If you would like to participate in the Q&A, please register here:[Q&A Registration Link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F101773086%3Fpwd%3D6oSYb9bq&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=Q%26amp%3BA+Registration+Link&index=4&md5=b9486b6b0d52ddb4ea28a8e635616911)


**About Extreme Networks:**


Extreme Networks, Inc. ([EXTR](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ffinance.yahoo.com%2Fquote%2Fextr%2F&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=EXTR&index=5&md5=ed4fb67d1a7d1115091debf1b7bcbccc) ) is a leader in AI-powered automation for networking, focused on delivering simple and secure solutions that help businesses address challenges and enable connections among devices, applications, and users. We push the boundaries of technology, leveraging the powers of artificial intelligence, analytics, and automation. Tens of thousands of customers globally trust our AI-powered cloud networking solutions and industry-leading support to enable businesses to drive value, foster innovation, and overcome extreme challenges. For more information, visit Extreme's website at[www.extremenetworks.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.extremenetworks.com%2F%3Futm_campaign%3D24_PR_Q1ResultsCall_0000_CORP_AAD_REF_LPG_WW_EN_PRE_home%26utm_medium%3DReferral%26utm_source%3DQ1ResultsCall%26utm_content%3Dhome&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=www.extremenetworks.com&index=6&md5=95771b498dc6464e4cd2ccc2a187fbc3) or follow us on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fextreme-networks%2F&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=7&md5=c1a4442a7c0937504777ccbab33b8d76) ,[YouTube](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fchannel%2FUCMtPKoR8ZCx9gdcDTqHj_iA%2Ffeed&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=YouTube&index=8&md5=fccf66b5ac6a8383769785676a19fff2) ,[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fextremenetworks&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=9&md5=943a6b5a6d0c0f7804c5f6ebaf83ae32) ,[Facebook](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2Fextremenetworks&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=Facebook&index=10&md5=6ecf214246c4a0753fe5c4d6adbd2390) , or[Instagram](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.instagram.com%2Fextremenetworks%2F&esheet=54568073&newsitemid=20260709936762&lan=en-US&anchor=Instagram&index=11&md5=c81ca9c7c2d735c68508e26ecd429beb) .
